summary: Tonight's consolidation covers editor signals from DAN, AMO, ZEC, EZK, NUM, ECC, MIC, and 1CH. Six general-tier or book-scoped TN decision rules were synthesized from 169 candidate clusters: a template for translating name notes with context, quotation-structure note guidance, figs-infostructure templates, figs-idiom deduplication discipline against figs-metaphor, translate-symaction content structure, and a book-scoped writing-foreground rule for Aramaic discourse particles in Daniel. Four stale overridden rows in ult_decisions.csv were also surfaced for human removal.
